scope: Incremental static read guard; only migrated boundaries, not a whole-repository World ban or a complete JavaScript analyzer

compatibilityDebt.TerrainReadView: this.world[name] is restricted by existing TERRAIN_LAYERS; initial/overflow copies and changed rectangles only. Actual Canvas/Three terrain upload retains existing World/terrainChanges facade.
compatibilityDebt.Canvas drawEntities: One optional World.entities fallback remains for legacy realm-view/API callers. Production mortal main passes RenderFrame. Terrain height, idx and faction palette calls remain legacy.
compatibilityDebt.Three deriveEntities: No direct canonical world.entities list; auxiliary wanling/biyi/wraiths, factions and terrain/appearance facades remain legacy.
compatibilityDebt.Query: settlementInspectCard remains the bounded existing projection fact reader; its transitive society/condition reads are registered debt.
compatibilityDebt.Other main/G1/Camera/Presentation/UI: Unmigrated reads and authoritative observation/commands remain listed in READ_SURFACE; no global prohibition.
